names.VBTLX: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Adm
names.VBMFX: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Inv

sources.prices: Yahoo Finance adjusted close (total return, distributions reinvested), month-end
sources.fedfunds: FRED FEDFUNDS, effective federal funds rate, monthly average, %
sources.tbill: FRED TB3MS, 3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate, monthly average, %
sources.rates: FRED DGS10, 10-year Treasury constant maturity, month-end (for rate betas)
sources.vbtlxYield: Bloomberg US Agg yield-to-worst proxy: FRED DGS7 + 0.25 x ICE BofA US Corporate OAS (BAMLC0A0CM; before its FRED history, scaled Moody's AAA10Y/BAA10Y) + 0.27 x (MORTGAGE30US - DGS10, demeaned) + constant fitted to published Agg YTW (Meketa; Hartford Funds), month-end
sources.vipixYield: FRED DFII7 (7-year TIPS real yield, month-end) + T7YIEM (7-year breakeven inflation, monthly)
